useCases.title: Private AI
useCases.description: Private AI workloads, local model serving, and user-facing AI workbench intent.

notes: Same CPU runtime as standard. A GPU is a separate accelerator profile, not a compute tier.

low.reason: CPU inference needs the explicit standard hardware floor.

notes: No model is installed automatically. Model weights and context determine additional RAM and disk.

settings.name: Accelerator
settings.help: Local models run far faster on a GPU.

options.name: CPU only
options.note: Works everywhere; small models only

options.name: NVIDIA GPU
options.note: Needs the NVIDIA driver 550 or newer; StackKits sets up the NVIDIA Container Toolkit

options.name: AMD GPU
options.note: ROCm-capable card with the amdgpu driver; amd64 only

settings.name: Model size
settings.help: Larger models answer better and need more memory.

options.name: Small
options.note: Around 4 GB of memory, e.g. Qwen 3.5 4B

options.name: Medium
options.note: Around 8 GB of memory, e.g. Qwen 3.5 9B

options.name: Large
options.note: 16 GB of memory or more, e.g. Qwen 3.5 27B

settings.name: Where the models run
settings.help: Run models on your own hardware, or use only your own interface with a provider you already pay for.

options.name: On my own hardware
options.note: Models run on this Node; private, no per-message cost

options.name: Only my own interface
options.note: Your own chat on top of OpenAI, Anthropic or another provider; no models on your hardware

settings.name: General chat model
settings.help: Download an everyday chat model during setup so the first chat works offline.

settings.name: Coding model
settings.help: Download a code model for the agent harness and your editor.

settings.name: External image and video providers
settings.help: Let ComfyUI generate through external providers, so it works without a GPU. Off by default: nothing leaves the Node. When on, you sign in to your own Comfy.org account inside ComfyUI, prompts and images are sent to those providers, and their use may cost money on your provider account.

settings.name: Vision model
settings.help: Download a model that understands images you drop into the chat.

capabilities.name: Inference
capabilities.help: Serves the models you download; every other AI module uses this local endpoint.

capabilities.name: Chat and knowledge
capabilities.help: Chat with your local models and your own documents.

alternative.name: AnythingLLM
alternative.note: Workspaces with built-in RAG and agents, multi-user mode; parses documents itself, so Tika and Docling are not selectable with it

capabilities.name: Speech
capabilities.help: Speak to your assistant and hear answers; recognition runs on your device where it can.

default.name: kombify SpeechKit
default.pending: waiting for a SpeechKit release with OpenAI audio endpoints and a public image

capabilities.name: Web search
capabilities.help: Private meta search for chat and the assistant.

capabilities.name: Document parsing
capabilities.help: Reads PDFs and office files so chat can answer from them.

alternative.name: Docling
alternative.note: For scanned and complex layouts; needs more memory

capabilities.name: Image and video
capabilities.help: Create and edit images and short videos from reviewed workflow templates.

default.name: ComfyUI
default.note: No GPU needed: runs on the CPU (slow; upscaling, and text-to-image with 32 GB RAM), on an NVIDIA GPU with 8 GB for fast images (video needs 16 GB of VRAM), or through optional external providers with the comfyui-api-nodes setting

capabilities.name: Personal assistant
capabilities.help: An assistant with memory that drafts and inspects first; every further permission is a separate grant.

default.name: Hermes Agent
default.note: Experimental; one owner, inspect and draft by default

alternative.name: OpenBot
alternative.note: Supervised AI coworker with its own workspace; needs a paid CopilotKit Intelligence plan to self-host

capabilities.name: Agent harness
capabilities.help: Task and coding agents that run only inside isolated workspaces.

default.name: OpenHands
default.note: Runs in a gVisor sandbox; the host needs the runsc runtime

alternative.name: Goose
alternative.note: Desktop app and CLI; no self-hostable web surface yet

capabilities.name: Agent control plane
capabilities.help: Organizes agents, their budgets and approvals.

default.name: Paperclip
default.note: Runs in a gVisor sandbox; the host needs the runsc runtime

alternative.name: Langflow
alternative.note: Visual agent and flow builder; runs flow code in-process

capabilities.name: Model router and API access
capabilities.help: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint with a token for your apps and devices.

default.name: LiteLLM
default.note: Apps and devices use the master key from owner custody

alternative.name: Langfuse
alternative.pending: needs its own PostgreSQL and ClickHouse stack

capabilities.name: Vector store
capabilities.help: Keeps the knowledge-base vectors of your chat module in Qdrant instead of its built-in store (Chroma in Open WebUI, LanceDB in AnythingLLM). Off by default.

default.name: Qdrant
default.note: Open source from Berlin with its own MCP server; the API key comes from owner custody

bundles.name: My local AI

bundles.name: Creative studio
bundles.help: Create images and improve old photos, on the CPU, a GPU or an optional external provider.

bundles.name: My personal assistant

examples: Summarise appointments and weather each morning
Draft replies and reach you through a messenger
